reverse_engineering.identity_and_provenance: All three are 443392-byte unsigned native x64 PE variants of an OFX-extension ransomware/Discord RAT. The Microsoft Corporation, Microsoft Windows, Windows System Cache and syscache.exe version-resource fields are unverified claims, not Microsoft provenance. Forager retrieved original SHA-256 5ca11fb0605c517cc6c4943d746956dc7023f1366b1a13c83033dfb3424cf3cf from Triage, preserving its .forage.json in scratch. Byte comparison establishes exact mutations; no original was reconstructed.
reverse_engineering.encryption: Main 0x140016d20 reaches the crypto initializer at 0x1400187ce. 0x1400036c0 selects AES/ChainingModeGCM; 0x140003750 generates the 32-byte session key and 12-byte nonce. 0x140003830 uses BCryptEncrypt; file workers call it at 0x140006676 and 0x1400067d0 and write the transformed buffers. 0x140003920 imports an RSA public blob and seals the key. The successful-file branch at 0x140006876 sets a true byte, then submits class 13 FileDispositionInformation at 0x1400068a1 against the source handle. 0x1400160a0 builds the payment-conditioned decryptor demand and key blob. These effects establish destructive extortion independently of strings naming an algorithm.
reverse_engineering.command_source_to_sink: A worker constructs /channels/<id>/messages?limit=15 at 0x14001f6b9, invokes the HTTP helper at 0x14001f74b, parses JSON and orders message records. At 0x14001f988 it passes record content to dispatcher 0x1400131f0. The shell branch compares the task token, converts its received remainder at 0x14001441c, appends it to UTF-16 cmd.exe /c at 0x140014430, and passes that constructed command to 0x140012340. This helper creates a pipe, installs inherited stdout/stderr, calls CreateProcessW at 0x14001248d, and reads the same pipe handle at 0x14001253d and 0x1400125e6. The dispatcher wraps the output and sends it at 0x14001449d. In the no-shell-task-verb specimen, the comparison target is !help: it still executes shell commands.
reverse_engineering.file_and_screen_transfer: The !dl branch converts the operator-selected path at 0x14001407f and passes it to multipart uploader 0x140010bb0 at 0x14001408b. The screen branch calls 0x14000e5a0 at 0x14001455a. That helper queries desktop dimensions, obtains GetDC(0), BitBlts from that DC, and saves the bitmap through GDI+. The resulting buffer is written to a temporary PNG, its same path goes to 0x140010bb0 at 0x1400146a6, then DeleteFileW removes it at 0x1400146c6. In the no-screen-task-verb specimen, !status selects this unchanged capture/upload path. Startup reporting at 0x1400152f0 also includes host information and a captured image.
reverse_engineering.additional_payload_execution: The !up branch supplies an operator URL and generated temporary executable path to 0x140011e10. This HTTP download helper writes the response to the supplied path; success reaches CreateProcessW for that path at 0x140014332. The downloaded payload itself is absent. Existing HTTP, file-write, process-execution and RAT traits cover its primitives. No separate fully interprocedural download-to-execution matcher is claimed.
reverse_engineering.obfuscation: For byte j: state=(seed-j*multiplier)&0xffffffff; plaintext=ciphertext XOR ((state XOR (state>>15))&255). Instruction operands and initialized stack bytes were independently decoded in each sample. Recovered strings include ntdll.dll, AmsiScanBuffer, EtwEventWrite, analysis-injected module names, USERNAME and COMPUTERNAME. The Run-key string is reconstructed from two constant vectors and immediate bytes. Manual PE export walks hash names with FNV-1a. The independent decode output is in decoded-checks.json in scratch.
reverse_engineering.persistence: Main reaches 0x1400161f0 at 0x140018af9. GetModuleFileNameW supplies the source image path; CopyFileW at 0x1400167db copies it into an application-data location. Decoder 0x140016880 yields Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run. RegOpenKeyExW opens HKCU at 0x14001693a and RegSetValueExW at 0x140016a49 stores the copied path.
reverse_engineering.security_patches: All three decode the actual AmsiScanBuffer and EtwEventWrite names. After export resolution and successful VirtualProtect, 0x140017daa and 0x140017db5 write B8 57 00 07 80 C3 (return E_INVALIDARG), while 0x140017f3b writes 33 C0 C3 (return zero) to EtwEventWrite. Existing hostile patch detections are supported and retained.
reverse_engineering.anti_analysis: The PEB BeingDebugged check at 0x140016d63 is immediately followed by a test of PEB.NtGlobalFlag at +0xbc, mask 0x70, with a conditional rejection branch. Additional debugger API, debug-register, Wine and concealed analysis-module probes are present. Existing resource checks test five-minute uptime, two processors, 2 GiB RAM and 1024x768 dimensions. In different-resource-abort-destination.exe the uptime conditional goes to 0x1400180bd, one byte before the common epilogue at 0x1400180be. Disassembly from 0x1400180bd begins add [rbx],dh and misaligned instructions: it is not the same return path. The shared-abort timing rule correctly remains absent there; it is retained in the other variants.
reverse_engineering.judgment_balance: Encryption, process creation and remote support have legitimate uses separately. Destructive source-file disposition, payment-gated recovery, operator shell/file/desktop access, concealed startup and security patching together tip all three judgments to MALICIOUS. No authorization workflow or legitimate Microsoft implementation is established. Actual deployment context, operator identity and runtime success are unknown. No specimen was executed.

rule_changes.tasking: Retain the original !exec evidence as an alternative, and add a structural pipe-handler alternative. The new neutral pipe trait binds the conditional handler to its callee entry, resolves CreatePipe/CreateProcessW/ReadFile IAT operands, and compares the pipe output and read-handle stack slots. No operator command spelling, filename, fixed RVA or file size is required.
rule_changes.screen: Retain !screen as an alternative and add a neutral desktop-capture-handler observation. It binds the comparison-controlled callee, shared capture-buffer slots, desktop metrics/GetDC/BitBlt IAT operands and screen-copy argument registers, independent of task spelling or temporary filename.
rule_changes.debug_flags: Extend the existing NtGlobalFlag mask trait with adjacent x64 BeingDebugged-to-NtGlobalFlag branch forms. Preserve every old alternative and existing platform/type/architecture scope.
rule_changes.preservation: No trait was removed, narrowed, demoted or moved. Both objective changes are monotonic OR expansions, and every old NtGlobalFlag byte alternative remains. All sample findings and criticalities are retained. The historical regression generator now expects retained behaviors when shell/screen verbs are renamed.
rule_changes.placement: The pipe matcher describes a command handler creating a child pipe and reading its same handle, under communications/ipc/pipe. It does not identify a shell by itself. Desktop capture belongs under hardware/display/screenshot. The security-specific PEB flag check remains under debugger-detect/check. Exact and ancestor consumers were inspected; scans gained only the intended neutral, anti-debug and restored hostile findings.
rule_changes.limitations: Compiler-shaped native matchers are not general binary taint analysis. Other concealed environment checks and native clean-image restoration have supporting low-level observations but no new dedicated signatures in this change. The interprocedural native download/execute chain is documented without inventing a loose co-occurrence conviction.

verification.negative_controls: Broken handler callees, mismatched branch destinations, wrong IATs, capture-buffer/pipe-handle mismatches, wrong PEB field/mask, and four existing benign executables. Mutating only one of two valid pipe reads correctly retains coverage; breaking both removes it. Removing the ransom-text leg retains neutral handlers without the extortion tasking/exfiltration composites. Five old PEB forms and the separately fetched original retain coverage.
verification.scan_mode: atomscan --no-update --analyze local --mode slow --format json, before and after for each original supplied path
